content.text: Cleaning up the unnecessary async wrapping, then running lint.

Fixed. Resend and edit were sending text only, so attachments never made it into the new request.

**What changed**
- **Resend** reloads the original images/documents and includes them again
- **Edit** keeps the original attachments and also forwards any newly added ones from the editor
- Persisted images (`/i/{id}`) are fetched and re-encoded so they can be sent through the existing upload payload

Lint passes. Worth a quick check: resend a message with an image and with a file, then edit one that has both.
